name: E2B Machines
description: Run sessions in E2B cloud sandboxes that pause when idle and keep their disk.

provider.label: E2B sandbox
provider.description: A Linux sandbox in E2B's cloud. Pauses with its memory and disk when idle.

schema.label: E2B API key
schema.description: From e2b.dev/dashboard. E2B_API_KEY is also read.

schema.label: Template
schema.description: Sandbox template name or id. A template with Node and git preinstalled starts fastest.

schema.label: Auto-pause after (minutes)
schema.description: E2B pauses the sandbox (keeping memory and disk) after this long without a resume.
